statement: The bound W >= (log N)^55 in the abstract of arXiv:2609.24426 does not address the limit N -> infinity with any fixed finite W.
proof: For fixed W, (log N)^55 exceeds W once N > exp(W^(1/55)). This is only a quantifier/scope observation, not a localization proof.
remaining_gap: Recover and verify the exact C0054 model and prove fixed-bandwidth bulk localization.
